finding_status.evidence: Owner decision: fall back to the parent span only when the dispatch has no agentId at all; a known agentId with no api_request group yields NULL. Implemented as `LEFT JOIN parent_usage pu ON pu.span_id = t.parent_span_id AND la.agent_id IS NULL`. The live orphan test previously passed only by accident (its hook event had no tool_name='Agent' and an empty parent span); it now seeds a real Agent hook event under a main-thread span with its own api_request and failed before the fix (main-thread cost 0.5 leaked onto the orphan), passes after.

Found in this round: the first_start filter of the original `lr` CTE had been dropped, so the fallback (and every skill dispatch row) summed the parent span's whole api_request total instead of counting from the first dispatch on, contradicting the docstring's 'as before'. Restored first_start and the FILTER (WHERE after) sums in parent_usage. New live test test_a_dispatch_with_no_agent_id_falls_back_to_its_parent_span_from_its_start_on failed before (0.37) and passes after (0.07).
